response.sql: SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the average of Track.UnitPrice over all track rows, so each track counts once and the baseline is not an average of the per-media-type averages.
The database is SQLite, and NULLS LAST is supported (SQLite 3.30 or later). The schema's style suggests SQLite, but the context does not name the engine.

Media types are taken only from Track.MediaTypeId, as the request specifies, so media types with no tracks do not appear. A ratio is NULL only if the baseline is zero or NULL, which SQLite returns as NULL on division by zero, and such rows sort last.
